instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

For task-5766337d, identify the distinct outline color and background, then fill every background cell in a fully enclosed orthogonal cavity with color 4. Leave the outline and all non-enclosed background unchanged. The fill color is 4 regardless of the input palette. Validated demos: a one-cell cavity bounded by color 5 on background 8 becomes 4; a 3×4 cavity bounded by color 2 on background 6 becomes all 4. Fresh accepted tests: (1) a 3×3 cavity bounded by color 6 on background 3 was filled with 4, while the exterior remained 3; (2) a 19×10 grid with background 7 and outline 1 had a fully enclosed 3×3 cavity at zero-based rows 15–17 and columns 3–5. Fill exactly those nine cells with 4 and preserve the outline, including horizontal boundaries at rows 14 and 18 and side boundaries in columns 2 and 6. This confirms enclosure is based on orthogonal background connectivity, not overall shape symmetry.

Additional accepted test: 16×13 grid, background 7 and outline 6, with the outline cells at r2 c2–6, r3 c0–2 and c6–12, r4 c2 and c6, and r5 c2–6 (zero-based). The enclosed cavity is exactly the six background cells r3–4, c3–5; change all six to 4. Keep all outline cells unchanged, especially the outline segments on r3 c0–2 and c6–12. Important execution lesson: do not reconstruct/fill the entire shape as outline; fill only the original background cells in the enclosed cavity. An initial wrong answer mistakenly changed r3 c3–5 to outline color 6; changing those cells to 4 produced the accepted output.
